answer: What separates one agent from a thousand clones is Mustmaker skin standard entered in the cask tally, and the separation is 6-year cellar service, 106 supervised pressings, blending exam, annual ledger dues. A clone costs 89 POA to mint and 13 minutes to prove; 604 clones cost 53756 POA and 7852 minutes to keep. Measure the vertex in years, measure the lagoon in POA, and measure the shale in signatures: a farm is short on all three. One credential, honestly earned, outweighs a thousand printed at midnight.
